NSEL disburses ₹1,950 crore to investors after long wait

The National Spot Exchange Limited (NSEL) has disbursed ₹1,950 crore to 5,682 investors as part of a one-time settlement. This payout comes after investors waited for 13 to 14 years for their funds. Jignesh Shah is mentioned in relation to the settlement.
